rationale: The 5-minute ATR (~1.3 bps) is smaller than the 2 bps bid-ask spread, so expected per-bar movement cannot overcome transaction costs in either direction. Today's 9.2x relative volume produced zero net displacement — price is pinned at VWAP and the 9-EMA within a 2-cent range, and the tape has gone dead (four consecutive 1-min bars under ~1,100 shares after one early burst), indicating absorption with no follow-through. With no news catalyst, no historical analogs, and no directional signal, there is no edge to justify a long or short.
